notes.title: Update 5.5.0: New Notifications System, Tribute Visuals Updated and more
notes.notes:
This update brings new tools and refinements to your journey through Mission 1

List of Updates 5.5.0 Brings:
Notifications System - The first iteration is here to keep you on top of resources, Sinners, and events in your domain.

Tribute Visuals - Brand new look to the Tribute objective panel.

New Souls Movement - Refining the movement of the Souls to consume less processing and improve game performance through the game.

Additional Improvements - General fixes and inconsistencies fixes


Share Your Feedback
Join the discussion on Steam Discussions or Discord to share your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.

notes.title: Tutorial Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
We know it’s been a while since our last update, and you might be wondering what we’ve been working on behind the scenes. Well… we’ve been quietly brewing something important.



We’re thrilled to finally share that the Tutorial is on the way, and you’ll be able to play it very soon!



No more “Why why why?” or “How how how?”


We’ve built a brand-new guided experience that walks you through the core mechanics, helping you get a much better grip on how to survive and thrive in The HELL.



This is just the beginning, we’re getting closer to our next big milestone, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.
